description: The bar chart, titled "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision," compares the performance of two systems—labeled "Ours" and "Standard"—across three categories: "Text," "Generated Response," and "Other." The vertical axis lists the two systems, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage of performance, with values ranging from 0% to 100%. Each bar is segmented into three colored portions corresponding to the categories, with a legend indicating that blue represents "Text," orange represents "Generated Response," and green represents "Other." For the "Ours" system, the "Text" category accounts for 60.6%, the "Generated Response" category accounts for 31.7%, and the "Other" category accounts for 7.7%. For the "Standard" system, the "Text" category accounts for 23.6%, the "Generated Response" category accounts for 51.1%, and the "Other" category accounts for 25.3%. The chart illustrates that the "Ours" system has a significantly higher proportion of performance attributed to "Text" compared to the "Standard" system, while the "Standard" system shows a higher proportion for "Generated Response" and "Other."
